theorems.name: Submission.cmr_coordinate_covectors_span
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ I : Fin n → Fin P, ∃ θ : Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ v : Fin n → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) ∧ ∀ ζ : MultiVector P n, (∀ (I : Fin n → Fin P) (θ : Covector (Euclid P) n), StrictMono I → (∀ v : Fin n → Euclid P, θ v = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k j => v j (I k))) → ζ θ = 0) → ζ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
